Name: Non-Smoking Sebastian
Author: Prismuth
Description:
[size=4]--THIS IS NOT A SMAPI MOD. FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS BELOW IF YOU WANT THE MOD TO WORK PROPERLY--[/size]

[size=3][u]Installation Instructions[/u]:[/size]
1. Make sure you have Sebastian's sprite and dialogue backed up in case you want to revert.
2. Download and unpack the mod.
3. Navigate to the Content folder of your install, and into the Characters folder inside of it.
4. Place Sebastian.xnb in the characters folder, and then go to the Dialogue folder inside the Characters folder.
5. Put MarriageDialogueSebastian.xnb and Robin.xnb in the aforementioned Dialogue folder

[u][size=3]Compatibility:[/size]
[/u]- It is not compatible with anything else that changes Sebastian's sprite sheet.
- It is not compatible with anything that replaces Sebastian's marriage dialogue, or Robin's general dialogue.

[u][size=3]Permissions:[/size]
[/u]- If you want to make a fancier dialogue mod, with additions, (like doki doki, or 100 more lines) that removes his smoking habit, you may use my sprite for him that has him playing a game instead. Or add him to an additional one. Just give credit and let me know! (if a non smoking option is added to one of the awesome dialogue mods that'd actually make me really happy since then I could have both)

[u][size=3]Mod Description:[/size][/u]

When I was first looking into the game, Sebastian caught my eye, but was instantly turned off as soon as I found out he was a smoker. Every now and then I'd look into if there was a mod that fixed it. Once I learned how to mod, I realized "hey, I can do this myself~!" And when I finished, I thought I'd share it with people in case other people like the idea of him but just couldn't bring themselves to marry him or anything because of him smoking.

To anyone upset I removed it, well, you don't have to download this, now do you.

ALSO, if there's any other dialogue that mentions it, other than what I could find, let me know, since all I could find was two lines in Sebastian's marriage dialogue, and two lines of Robin's Dialogue.

But yeah, really just something I made for myself and thought I'd share it in case anyone else wanted it.
